None.description: This enigmatic component, shrouded in mystery, subtly enhances agility and dexterity, granting its bearer an almost supernatural grace and nimbleness that is particularly potent within the verdant embrace of forests and the tangled expanse of jungles.

Mottled.description: This irregularly patterned hide grants the bearer a natural agility and stealth, perfectly camouflaged against the dappled light and shadows of dense woodland and jungle environments, enhancing their dexterity and allowing them to move with eerie grace and unpredictability.

Striped.description: The Striped component is a rare genetic trait, marked by sleek, lightning-fast reflexes that grant unparalleled agility, perfectly adapted for the open expanses of grasslands and the dense, tangled jungles, where stealth and swift movement are paramount.

Spotted.description: The Spotted component bestows upon its bearer a keen agility and a natural camouflage that allows them to blend seamlessly into the verdant shadows of the forest, enhancing their dexterity and granting them a silent presence among the trees.

Brindled.description: The Brindled component endows its bearer with the lithe grace and agility of the forest's most elusive creatures, enhancing their dexterity to move with the fluidity of a jungle cat, while forging a deeper connection to the verdant realms of Forest and Jungle.

Scarred.description: The Scarred component is a testament to resilience and cunning, granting its bearer an agile edge in the verdant undergrowth of forests and jungles, where the twisting vines and dense foliage provide the perfect cover for those marked by battles and scars.

Banded.description: The Banded entity component is marked by sleek, intertwining stripes that run along the length of its sinuous form, granting it an unparalleled agility and grace that is particularly attuned to the dense undergrowth and vertical canopy of forests and jungles.
